The store is **Pine Crossing**. I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread with that answer.

- **Where it comes from:** Pree posted it herself in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.
- **Status unclear:** Hollis said he would check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem using the store's login. There's no update on that later in the channel. I told Pree to confirm it was fixed before she marks the store ready on the account sheet.
- **How I checked:** I only used #central-team, which Pree belongs to, and public files. Those files gave no separate site code beyond the store name.

**gbrain wasn't used:** gbrain refused my search with `requester_scope_required`. The connection isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. To fix that, someone who runs the brain host has to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. If one assistant serves several people, the alternative is to set it up with `--may-act-for`. I didn't change anything there.
